known_limitations: Frequent-word and rare-word pruning were fitted on the full corpus (train+test) before the train/test split, matching the supplied notebook's own cell order. This is a pre-existing train/test leakage in the baseline pipeline, preserved here to keep exported metrics faithful to the original notebook rather than silently changed.
LinearSVC is a batch model with no incremental-learning support. It is the static baseline only; the adaptive online model is a separate River MultinomialNB pipeline (see artifacts/adaptive_model).
